title: Axiom of empty set
summary: There exists a set with no members.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared first-order set theory context is fixed.

content.plain: There exists a set with no members.
content.exact: ∃A∀x ¬(x∈A). Extensionality then makes this memberless set unique, so it is denoted ∅.
content.example: The object ∅ supplies a base case for set constructions.
content.caveat: Some axiom lists derive empty-set existence from stronger axioms instead of naming it separately.
